slides.heading: Three-Point Lighting Mastery
slides.text: Key, Fill, and Backlight: the sacred trinity of filmmaking. Learn how to mold light to separate subjects from background noise.

slides.heading: The Power of Negative Fill
slides.text: Sometimes what you remove is more important than what you add. Negative fill absorbs bounce light, deepening shadows and amplifying drama.

slides.heading: Color Temperature Contrast
slides.text: Mixing 3200K tungsten warmth with 5600K cool daylight creates dynamic depth that instantly draws viewer fascination.

slides.heading: Lighting in Motion
slides.text: When the camera moves, lighting must hold its narrative integrity. Gimbals, dollies, and handheld rigs require intentional light placement.
